definitions.ask: Should later edits to the file at a pasted path re-copy over its vault image?
definitions.why: macscrot names each capture uniquely, so frozen copies fit and vault files are never overwritten

choices.label: Copy once, never overwrite; delete the vault copy to re-import. No cross-host flapping
Re-copy when source bytes change so edits propagate; adds guarded overwrites, can flap
